cpu_scope: owned simulation processes only; SMT siblings excluded from owned background workloads; ordinary scheduler; host not reserved; Orin requires its own measurement
python_scope: ground validation and startup, lifecycle supervision and recovery, offline independent analysis; no ACTIVE snapshot construction, MPC step or normal actuator output
consumption_budget_scope: separate per-joint asynchronous progress watchdog anchored to oldest unresolved actual send; new sends do not renew it; not the output-period deadline
next_solve_commit: one next solve after matching actual writer send and a strictly newer source; measured model dt; no fabricated timestamps
ground_initialization: all processes and hash-bound libraries READY before takeoff; source remains UNBOUND; copy original fixed reference/reset binding once, verify ACK while legacy owns output, then publish actual LiveStart
diagnostic_policy: bounded ownership queue for raw worker CDR and Compact core results; auxiliary JSON/hash/file writer; bounded raw source CDR buffer persisted after shutdown; overflow or missing evidence fails acceptance
incomplete_run_policy: retain raw evidence, no certificate, do not advance to next stage
